title: PDB data audits: unrecorded covalent bonds, benchmark label conflicts, and silent mutation misclassification
description:
Audit tables for the Protein Data Bank and datasets derived from it. Includes: the 491-site / 289-entry strict cut of protein–ligand contacts at covalent bond length with no _struct_conn record (X-ray, ≤2.5 Å, class 2), with wwPDB real-space fit and clash values per site; the SARS-CoV-2 subset (73 sites / 46 entries; all 66 Mpro Cys145 sites density-supported); the remediation history of those sites, retrieved from the wwPDB versioned archive and the PDBj Snapshot Archive (141 sites in 88 entries were recorded in an earlier release, removed by a 2024–25 wwPDB revision and not re-filed; 104 of the 141 are density-supported); a cross-reference against LP-PDBBind identifying 20 covalent complexes labelled covalent=False and the curation mechanism behind it; overlap with the PoseBusters and Runs N' Poses benchmarks; the LP-PDBBind identical-ligand label conflicts filed as THGLab/LP-PDBBind#8; and the KRAS Rascore within-class comparison after correcting silent wildtype mislabels (mitch-parker/rascore#2).

Scan: RCSB PDB snapshot 20261013T233952Z, 199,603 entries. Validation values: wwPDB validation report XML as served by PDBe, retrieved 2026-10-17. Earlier releases: wwPDB versioned archive and PDBj Snapshot Archive, retrieved 2026-10-18. Every downloaded source carries a URL and SHA-256 in the accompanying README.
